postconditions.description: The number of genes G is greater than 2.
The number of rows in the mutation table N is at least G - 2.
The number of antibodies M is non-negative.

postconditions.expression: all(2 <= a < G for a in range(N))
postconditions.description: Each row in the mutation table specifies a gene a (2 ≤ a < G) and a sequence of k genes (0 ≤ b_i < G).

postconditions.expression: all(k >= 1 for _, k, _ in [mutation_table[i] for i in range(N)])
postconditions.description: Each row in the mutation table has at least one gene sequence.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= b_i < G for _, _, b_i in [mutation_table[i] for i in range(N)])
postconditions.description: Each gene in the mutation table is within the range [0, G).

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= l for l, _ in [antibody for antibody in antibodies])
postconditions.description: Each antibody has at least one fragment.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= c_i <= 1 for _, c_i in [antibody for antibody in antibodies])
postconditions.description: Each fragment in an antibody is either 0 or 1.
The total number of genes in the mutation table does not exceed 100.
The total number of fragments in all antibodies does not exceed 50.
